card.title: Nintendo Switch When both Joycons are docked A Joycon disconnects Repair

source.title: Nintendo Switch When both Joycons are docked A Joycon disconnects Repair

symptoms: one Joy-Con disconnects when the other is used

claims.statement: If one docked Joy-Con disconnects when the other gets input (and shows a wireless icon while docked), replace that side's rail; check for liquid on the rail/ribbon and clean with IPA first.

procedure: Identify which side shows wireless while docked.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
